a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we both almost certainly die before the reserve reaches 8. So I'm proposing a change rather than breaking our deal quietly. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the random split likely leaves us both short. Please don't take this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that and won't take anything more, so you can build the reserve back to 4 and take it. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.
